Built for stock decisions, not stock spreadsheets

See what is in dispatch, what is sitting in holding, what suppliers are sending, and what needs moving before orders stall.

Dispatch vs Holding Stock

Separate stock on hand by dispatch and holding locations, then see exactly where replenishment should come from.

Action Required Lists

Turn days-left, holding cover, and supplier lead time into practical actions like pick up stock from Manchester.

Work Task Creation

Select multiple replenishment actions and create warehouse tasks with stock codes, quantities, source, and destination.

Order Routing

Group orders by postcode area, focus on pending work, and use city-level views to plan fulfilment by location.

Supplier Lead Times

Track suppliers, purchase orders, acknowledgement times, dispatch times, delivery estimates, and incoming stock.

Workflow Intelligence

Design trigger-based workflows for orders, stock changes, suppliers, and tasks, then test the branch path before going live.

Execution Analytics

Monitor workflow runs, failed executions, skipped triggers, top events, and recent activity from one intelligence view.

How Nexus runs the operation

The platform watches the lifecycle of stock and orders, then presents the next best operational move.

1

Map Stock

Connect products to dispatch and holding locations so every SKU has a usable stock picture.

2

Detect Risk

Use dispatch stock and velocity to surface days-left, stockout risk, and supplier cover gaps.

3

Create Work

Convert recommended transfers and supplier actions into work tasks your warehouse can complete.

4

Audit Results

Track lifecycle hooks, workflow outcomes, and execution history so automation stays accountable.

Workflow Intelligence

A workflow engine for the messy middle of fulfilment

Build workflows from triggers, conditions, functions, notifications, delays, and webhooks. Test a dummy order payload and see which branch glows green before the workflow touches live operations.
